project_titles: Contract Q&A assistant over 12k legal documents
Domain fine-tune of an open LLM for insurance emails
Prompt evaluation harness for an AI startup

projects.title: Contract Q&A assistant over 12k legal documents
projects.problem: Paralegals spent hours searching contracts for clauses.
projects.approach: Chunked contracts by clause, added hybrid retrieval and citation-checked answers.
projects.result: cut clause lookup time from 25 minutes to under 2 minutes; 91% answer accuracy on a 200-question test set

projects.title: Customer-support chatbot with ticket deflection
projects.problem: A Shopify store's support inbox was overwhelmed during sales.
projects.approach: Built an intent router plus an LLM answerer grounded on the help centre, with human hand-off.
projects.result: deflected 38% of tickets in the first month

projects.title: Steel surface defect detection
projects.problem: Manual inspection missed hairline cracks on a production line.
projects.approach: Labelled 4,300 images, trained a detector, and deployed it on an edge box.
projects.result: recall on cracks rose from 72% to 94%

projects.title: Weekly demand forecasting for 600 SKUs
projects.problem: Stock-outs and overstock on fast-moving products.
projects.approach: Built hierarchical forecasts with gradient boosting and calendar features, retrained weekly.

projects.title: Subscription churn prediction
projects.problem: A SaaS company could not tell which accounts were about to cancel.
projects.approach: Engineered usage features, calibrated a classifier, explained drivers with SHAP.
projects.result: the retention team saved 140 at-risk accounts in a quarter

projects.title: Resume parsing with named-entity recognition
projects.problem: Recruiters re-typed candidate details from PDF resumes.
projects.approach: Fine-tuned a token classifier on 2,000 annotated resumes and wrapped it as an API.
projects.result: field-level F1 of 0.89; data entry time halved

projects.title: Domain fine-tune of an open LLM for insurance emails
projects.problem: Generic models wrote off-tone replies to policy holders.
projects.approach: Fine-tuned a 7B model with LoRA on 9k approved replies and evaluated with a rubric judge.

projects.title: Content recommendation engine
projects.approach: Two-tower retrieval plus a re-ranker, served behind a cache.

projects.title: Meeting transcription and summarisation
projects.problem: Consultants lost action items from long client calls.
projects.approach: Transcribed with Whisper, diarised speakers, summarised into action items with an LLM.
projects.result: summaries ready 3 minutes after a call ends

projects.title: Invoice OCR and field extraction
projects.problem: An accounting firm keyed in 5,000 invoices a month by hand.
projects.approach: Pre-processed scans, ran OCR, extracted totals and vendor fields with a layout model.
projects.result: 98.1% accuracy on totals; 3 FTE-days saved per week

projects.title: MLOps pipeline on SageMaker
projects.problem: Models were trained in notebooks and deployed by hand.
projects.approach: Built training, registry and blue-green deployment pipelines with automated checks.
projects.result: release time cut from two weeks to one day

projects.title: Multi-agent research assistant
projects.problem: Analysts spent days compiling competitor briefs.
projects.approach: Planner, researcher and critic agents with tool use and source-cited outputs.
projects.result: brief turnaround from 3 days to 4 hours

projects.title: Review sentiment analysis
projects.problem: A hotel chain could not track guest complaints across 40 properties.
projects.approach: Aspect-based sentiment model over 120k reviews with a weekly report.
projects.result: identified two recurring service issues that were then fixed

projects.title: Transaction anomaly detection
projects.problem: Card fraud was caught only after chargebacks.
projects.approach: Isolation forest plus rules with an analyst feedback loop.
projects.result: flagged 61% of fraud before settlement at a 0.4% false-positive rate

projects.title: Visual product search
projects.problem: Shoppers could not find products from photos.
projects.approach: CLIP embeddings with an approximate nearest-neighbour index.

projects.title: Chest X-ray triage classifier (research)
projects.problem: A research lab wanted a triage baseline for public X-ray data.
projects.approach: Transfer learning with careful patient-level splits and calibration.
projects.result: AUROC 0.87 on the held-out split; published as a reproducible notebook

projects.title: Prompt evaluation harness for an AI startup
projects.problem: Prompt changes kept silently breaking production behaviour.
projects.approach: Regression suite of 300 cases with LLM and rule graders running in CI.
projects.result: caught 11 regressions before release in two months

projects.title: WhatsApp appointment bot for clinics
projects.problem: Clinic receptionists handled hundreds of booking messages a day.
projects.approach: Intent and slot extraction bot integrated with the clinic calendar via the official API.
